abstract: A case of a dermoid cyst in the floor of the mouth in a 17-yr-old male is described. The diagnosis was made by fine-needle aspiration cytology and supported by histologic examination of the subsequently excised tissue. Dermoid cysts are benign lesions that can occur in the floor of the mouth. This case is presented to increase awareness of this entity and its occurrence in this location, and to demonstrate the feasibility of diagnosis by fine-needle aspiration. The cytologic and histologic features of dermoid cysts are described and discussed.
abstract_ja: 17歳男性の口腔底に発生した類皮嚢腫の1例を報告する。診断は穿刺吸引細胞診で行われ、切除された組織の組織学的検査で裏付けられた。類皮嚢腫は口腔底に発生しうる良性病変である。本症例は、この疾患とその本部位での発生への認識を高め、穿刺吸引による診断の実行可能性を示すために提示する。類皮嚢腫の細胞学的・組織学的特徴についても記述し、考察する。
